voiceover: It's Friday, 4:55pm. The feature works on your laptop, so you hit deploy. Now if it breaks, nobody's around to fix it, and your weekend becomes the on call shift. That's why teams have a rule: don't deploy on Fridays. Not because Friday is cursed. Because a fix takes longer when everyone's gone. Ship it Monday morning, when the whole team is awake and the coffee is hot. Send this to whoever just reached for the deploy button.
